question: How many customers do we have?
Top 5 customers by revenue last quarter
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= 'LQ_START' AND o.order_date < 'LQ_END' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY 3 DESC, c.customer_id LIMIT 5

question: What is the total revenue by product category?
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.category

question: Total revenue last month
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= 'LM_START' AND o.order_date < 'LM_END'

question: How many orders were cancelled?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

question: How many customers do we have in each country?
gold_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY country

question: Which product has sold the most units in completed orders?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average value of a completed order?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(t) FROM (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS t FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.order_id)

question: How many orders did we receive each month this year?
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date), COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= 'TY_START' AND order_date < 'TY_END' GROUP BY 1
